name: Michael Davis
title: CEO
facts: 20+ years in go-to-market leadership, scaling SaaS ventures and building high-performing teams
Passionate about wine-fueled adventures, trekking vineyard hillsides and unearthing hidden cellars across Europe
The father of three daughters who enjoys running a high-stakes negotiation firm at home
bio: Michael Davis is the CEO of FlowFuse. Over more than 20 years in go-to-market leadership, he has scaled SaaS companies and built the teams behind them. At FlowFuse, he spends much of his time with plant and operations leaders, helping them get industrial applications into production and take what works at one site to every other.
